IS 1380 : 2024 Ink, Finger Printing, Black - Specification
ICS 87.080
ICS 87.080
CHD 14
CHD 14
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for black finger printing ink used for taking impressions of fingers, thumbs and palms for the purpose of identification of persons.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this Indian Standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
